forms.title: Forms
forms.description: Edit or clear live PDF form values without flattening the document.
forms.detect_explanation: This PDF has no form fields. The app can look for empty boxes and lines in the page image.
forms.detect_empty: No empty fields were found on this page.
forms.detect_hint: Click a field on the page and type a value. Then save the filled copy.
forms.live_form_note: The saved copy remains an editable form. Appearance regeneration is requested only for changed text and choice fields.

ocr_edit.title: Scanned text
ocr_edit.description: Select words from a pipeline-created OCR layer, then erase them or replace them with visible text.
ocr_edit.no_layer: No editable OCR layer created by this app was identified on this page.
ocr_edit.selection_help: Click words to toggle them. Drag across the page to select several words.
ocr_edit.saved_erase: Erased copy saved. The matching invisible OCR spans were removed.
ocr_edit.saved_replacement: Replacement copy saved. The matching invisible OCR spans were removed.
ocr_edit.saved_patch_only: Copy saved. Span removal was skipped because the OCR spans could not be identified with certainty. The white patch was added.
ocr_edit.undo_note: The original file stays unchanged. Reload it to discard this saved-copy edit.

edit_text.title: Text
edit_text.click_empty_message: No editable text here. Add new text?
edit_text.no_runs: No editable text found on this page.
edit_text.scanned_title: This page is a scanned image
edit_text.scanned_explanation: The image has no text layer, so there is nothing to edit here. Find blank fields to fill in, or run OCR first to get editable text.

close_guard.title: Unsaved changes
close_guard.text_draft_hint: Apply the text edit first, then save.
